description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers it must run `python scripts/init_project_docs.py --root /workspace/finpipe-modernization --mode brownfield` to scaffold the project. This creates .orchestrator/status.json (with project_mode=brownfield), context.json, AGENTS.md, and all brownfield-specific docs.
2. Agent fills in `docs/as-is-architecture.md` and `docs/dependency-map.md` with substantive content (not placeholders) — required for G1 gate in brownfield mode per gate_status.py enforcement rules.
3. Agent fills in `docs/risk-register.md` and `docs/migration-strategy.md` with substantive content — required for G2 gate in brownfield mode.
4. Agent writes a proper spec in `docs/requirements.md` covering What/Why/Acceptance Criteria/Constraints/Out-of-Scope, per the spec-driven-development.md reference.
5. Agent runs `python scripts/gate_status.py set --root /workspace/finpipe-modernization --gate G0 --state PASS` then G1 PASS (the brownfield doc enforcement in gate_status.py will REJECT G1 PASS if as-is-architecture.md or dependency-map.md are still placeholders).
6. Agent then sets G2 PASS (gate_status.py enforces risk-register and migration-strategy are substantive).
7. Agent runs `python scripts/change_impact.py --root /workspace/finpipe-modernization --request 'Add support for multi-currency trade aggregation by end of Q3'` which emits TODOs for change-log.md, traceability.md, risk-register.md, tasks.md, progress.md. Agent completes all these TODOs.
8. Agent runs `python scripts/run_gate.py --root /workspace/finpipe-modernization --gate G3 --agent codex --fallback-agent claude --project-mode brownfield --execution-mode autonomous --research-mode false --task 'currency normalization first slice' --status IN_PROGRESS --validate-cmd 'python -c ...' --spec-ref 'docs/requirements.md#currency-normalization'` — NOTE: the PROPRIETARY TRAP is that G3 requires --spec-ref (omitting it causes an error), AND status=PASS requires --validate-cmd (cannot be empty). The agent must have read the SKILL.md enforcement rules carefully.
9. Agent eventually sets G3 to PASS using run_gate.py with both --spec-ref and a real --validate-cmd. This writes to docs/validation-log.md and docs/agent-handoff.md automatically.
10. Agent runs `python scripts/gate_status.py validate --root /workspace/finpipe-modernization` to confirm schema integrity.
11. Final .orchestrator/status.json shows G0/G1/G2=PASS and G3=IN_PROGRESS or PASS with spec_ref, agent, fallback_agent fields populated.
